main_text.p: ἥερμαy: & ε in o ἥορμαy, Ionicé ἀόρμαι, ἀόρ-σαy, ἀόρταy: tum ἀώρμην, ἀώρσο, ἀώρτο.
Tertia pluralis deest quum tertiæ singularis ᾱ impurum est, ac circumscribitur ut in praecedentibus horisticis: ἐσάλτο, ἐσαλμένοι ἦσαν, missus erat, missi erant. sic ἐλέλικτο, λελεγμένοι ἦσαν.
main_text.head: Cap. 24. De futuro perfecto septuplici.
main_text.p: Primum & secundum futurum fiunt á primo & secundo aoristo, sublato incremento, & mutato ῳ in ῶ.
Sic φιληθῶ, χρυσωθῶ: γαθῶ, τεθῶ, δδθῶ.
Iones in his duobus futuris ᾱ resolvunt in ἐω, ἡ

page.notes: Marginal or small letters "p" and "iiij" at the foot are a signature mark; Greek transcription is approximate where the scan is faded. Accents on the Greek forms are partly uncertain.
